name: Channel-Thieving Belt, Greater
body:
Source Horror Adventures pg. 219
Aura moderate conjuration and necromancy; CL 7th
Slot belt; Price 9,200 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This belt functions as a normal channel-thieving belt, except the amount of healing is equal to 1/2 the amount of damage dealt by the creature channeling energy.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, cure serious wounds, inflict serious wounds; Cost 4,600 gp
